caption: The drawing on a beige background depicts three technical views of a settee rendered in thin black lines: a top-down section view at the upper left, a front elevation at the lower left, and a side elevation at the lower right. The sectional view includes hatched orange lines to indicate cross-sectioned wood. All views display the settee's structural details, such as turned legs, horizontal seat slats, vertical supports, and scroll armrests. The front elevation shows four back supports and three seat divisions. A rectangular label at the upper right contains the text: “SETTEE / EARLY 19TH CENTURY / JACK M. BOCHNER / Bklyn Museum” and includes a scale in inches from 0 to 6. The drawing is otherwise uncolored besides the faint orange shading and is composed on plain, unruled paper.
title: Settee
